skill.displayName: Zero Trust For AI Maturity Assessment
skill.summary: Evaluates Zero Trust maturity across 6 principles for both Conventional (Infrastructure) and AI Era (Data & Model) dimensions.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Zero Trust for AI Maturity Assessment skill.
- Provides comprehensive maturity evaluation across 6 Zero Trust principles for both conventional (infrastructure) and AI (data & model) environments.
- Supports overall and principle-level scoring, benchmarking, and tailored recommendations.
- Offers endpoints for assessment submission, health checks, Zero Trust principle definitions, and domain-specific guidance.
- Designed for security teams, CISOs, and AI/ML leaders seeking to improve security posture in both traditional and AI contexts.
